geeklist.title: A Simple Prop to Occupy my Time Auction - US Paypal Ends 1/25/26
geeklist.description:
Auction Rules:
1. All games will be listed with a Starting Bid (SB) and a Buy-It-Now (BIN) price. Please do not bid below the SB.
2. All games inventoried and complete. Assume no inserts. Condition described for each game. Cards that are sleeved are either Ultra Pro or Sleeve Kings sleeves unless otherwise noted.
3. All bids must be in whole dollars. Bid increment is $1.
4. Shipping is from 27516 (NC) and will be paid by the winner. Local pick up (at I-40/Rte 86 Starbucks) is okay with prepayment via Paypal.
5. Shipping via [b][size=18]Pirateship[/size][/b] (USPS/UPS) to save over flat-rate shipping. I will combine shipping if you win multiple items.
6. US Only bidders please. Please don't bid if you don't plan to buy.
7. All transactions must be done via Paypal (Goods & Services) and through the BGG marketplace so BGG will get its 3% commission.
8. This particular auction will run until sometime in the evening of Sunday January 25, 2026 to discourage sniping.
9. I reserve the right to pull any games from the auction that have not been BIN'd. (Very, very unlikely to happen)
10. Payment is expected within 3 days of auction close.
11. If payment is not made, I reserve the right to award item(s) to the next highest bidder or relist.
12. One cat in my house.
13. Feel free to post/geekmail with any specific questions.
geeklist.comment: Reserved for 80s music nostalgia and auction notes.
This auction goes out to the one I love.
